name: FlowContent – AI Writing & SEO
author: flowcontent

sections.description:
Tired of spending hours writing blog posts? FlowContent writes them for you in minutes.

Struggling to rank on Google? Our SEO checker finds exactly what’s wrong and tells you how to fix it.

Forgetting to share your posts on social media? FlowContent automatically posts to Twitter, Facebook, and LinkedIn when you hit publish.

Write Blog Posts in Minutes, Not Hours

Stop staring at a blank page. Just tell FlowContent what you want to write about, and get a complete article ready to publish.

  • Write a 1000-word blog post in under 2 minutes
  • Generate catchy titles that get clicks
  • Create meta descriptions that boost your CTR
  • Write product descriptions that sell
  • Generate FAQ sections for better SEO

“I used to spend 4 hours on each blog post. Now I publish 3 articles per day.” – Sarah, Food Blogger

Find & Fix SEO Problems Instantly

Wonder why your posts don’t rank? FlowContent scans your content and shows you exactly what to fix.

  • Get an SEO score from 0-100 for every post
  • See which keywords you’re missing
  • Find titles that are too short or too long
  • Discover missing meta descriptions
  • Check if your images have alt text
  • Identify thin content that Google hates

One click to scan. Clear instructions to fix. Watch your rankings improve.

Auto-Post to Social Media

Stop copying and pasting links to every social network. FlowContent does it automatically.

  • Share to Twitter/X, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest
  • Auto-post when you publish (set it and forget it)
  • Schedule posts for the best times
  • Add hashtags automatically
  • Customize your message for each platform

Save 30 minutes per post on social media sharing.

What Can You Create?

  • Blog posts and articles
  • Product descriptions (WooCommerce ready!)
  • Landing page copy
  • Email newsletters
  • Social media posts
  • Meta descriptions
  • FAQ sections
  • Listicles and how-to guides

Works Where You Write

FlowContent lives right inside your WordPress editor. No need to switch tabs or copy-paste from another tool.

  • Works with Classic Editor
  • Works with Gutenberg Block Editor
  • Works with WooCommerce product pages

How Much Does It Cost?

The plugin is free to install. You get starter credits to try everything.

Need more? Credits start at just $9 for 100 generations. No monthly subscription required – pay only when you need more.

Languages Supported

Write content in: English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, and more.

Privacy Policy

FlowContent connects to FlowContent.io to power AI features. We process your content securely and never store it permanently. Social media connections are encrypted. See our full privacy policy at https://flowcontent.io/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install FlowContent from the WordPress plugin directory
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Click on “FlowContent” in your admin menu
  4. Connect your free FlowContent.io account (takes 30 seconds)
  5. Start writing with AI!
sections.faq:
How do I write a blog post with AI?

Just go to FlowContent > AI Generator, enter your topic (like “best coffee makers 2024”), select your preferences, and click Generate. You’ll have a complete article in about 60 seconds.

Will Google penalize AI-generated content?

No. Google has stated that AI content is fine as long as it’s helpful to readers. FlowContent creates high-quality, unique content. We recommend adding your personal touch before publishing.

How do I improve my SEO score?

Edit any post and look for the “FlowContent SEO” box. Click “Audit SEO” to scan your content. You’ll see a score and a list of issues with clear instructions on how to fix each one.

Can I automatically share posts to Facebook and Twitter?

Yes! In the post editor, check “Auto-share on publish” in the FlowContent Social box. Select which platforms you want, and your post will be shared automatically when you hit Publish.

How do I schedule social media posts?

In the FlowContent Social box, click “Schedule” instead of “Share Now”. Pick your date and time, and FlowContent will post it automatically.

Do I need to pay monthly?

No! Unlike other AI tools that charge $20-50/month, FlowContent uses a credit system. Buy credits when you need them. No recurring charges.

Is this better than ChatGPT?

FlowContent uses the same AI technology but is built specifically for WordPress. You don’t need to copy-paste or format anything – content goes straight into your editor, optimized for SEO.

Can I use this for my WooCommerce store?

Absolutely! FlowContent is perfect for writing product descriptions. Generate compelling descriptions that highlight benefits and include keywords that help products rank in Google.

What if I don’t like the generated content?

Click “Regenerate” to get a new version, or use the “Improve” tool to adjust the tone, length, or style. You can also edit the content directly – it’s your starting point, not the final word.

Is my content unique?

Yes, every generation is unique. The AI creates fresh content based on your specific topic and requirements.
